title: Workspace setup
job: Bring a workspace from its current records to its agreed business setup.

steps.title: Read the workspace
steps.instructions: Read the existing business profile, connections and capability readiness. Return a concise summary of facts and open setup items.
steps.done_when: Existing workspace facts and readiness have been recorded with their source.

steps.title: Confirm the business
steps.instructions: Confirm the business role and required work with the person. Save the confirmed profile and cite the person or source for each change.
steps.done_when: The person has confirmed the business profile and its intended work.

steps.title: Connect the required work
steps.instructions: Use current capability readiness to help the person connect the systems their work requires. Record selected services, their verified state and the next authorized work.
steps.done_when: The workspace has a verified setup record and an agreed next job.

done_when: The person has confirmed the business, the setup record states actual readiness, and the next job is agreed.
